status: canonical concept architecture draft; not yet wired into the live UI
purpose: Provide stable cross-lesson concept IDs so Course, Explore, Practice, mistakes, flashcards, and future Media Lab content can point to the same Korean concept instead of duplicating explanations.

sourcePolicy.teacherCore: Lesson appearances are grounded in the Lesson 1-14 teacher PPT curriculum and the existing system-map-v1.json.
sourcePolicy.enrichment: Broader linguistic organization, Chinese/Hanja aids, passive/causative expansion, and future media links must be labeled as enrichment when they go beyond the teacher PPTs.
sourcePolicy.migration: Existing lesson-local IDs remain valid during migration. Add canonicalConceptId later rather than breaking the current lesson packs.

futureEnrichmentNotTeacherCore.label: Passive system
futureEnrichmentNotTeacherCore.note: The current PPT set contains isolated passive-related material such as 보이다, but not a full passive morphology unit. A full passive Explore page must be labeled enrichment rather than teacher-core.
